Hi Dr. Hyder,

I wanted to send over a quick recap from today’s call and outline the next steps we have the girls working on so everyone stays aligned moving forward.

First off, we are incredibly excited about the opportunity here. Both locations have a ton of potential, especially with the combination of advanced devices, the longevity/wellness direction, and the medical credibility already attached to your practice.

A few major takeaways from today’s strategy session:

• Medford has a very strong opportunity due to lower market saturation and higher flexibility in positioning.
• Cinnaminson has strong authority leverage because of the physician-led component and existing reputation.
• The wellness + aesthetics combination (peptides, regenerative services, body contouring, skin treatments, injectables, etc.) is a major differentiator that we believe can become a huge competitive advantage.
• Educational and authority-driven content appears to be underutilized in your market, which gives us a strong opening.

Current Tasks & Action Items for the Team:

Alex:
• Friday tech/ad account audit call with Jacques
• Provide access/assets for current campaigns and devices
• Continue organizing operational and reporting information
• Upload Omniwave/Gainswave marketing assets into Slack/Drive
• Begin tracking baseline KPIs and reporting metrics

Ashley:
• Begin collecting before-and-after photos from every possible patient moving forward
• Push review generation aggressively at checkout
• Download and begin actively using Slack for communication
• Review initial deliverables/playbooks inside the Google Drive

Together:
• Review the 90-Day Checklist and Coaching Tracker
• Begin reviewing:
   - Membership Strategy
   - Package Architecture
   - Partnerships & Collaborations
   - Laser ROI Playbook
• Start thinking through June launch/event strategy for Medford

On our side, we are:
• Reviewing both market blueprints in detail
• Preparing membership/package restructuring recommendations
• Auditing current ad positioning and spend allocation
• Identifying community partnership opportunities
• Building positioning strategies around physician authority + wellness integration
• Preparing scaling recommendations for both locations

I also want to reiterate something important from the call: this is not just about ads. The real growth will come from tightening the entire client journey including consultations, packages, memberships, retention, reviews, partnerships, and community visibility.

I truly believe you all are positioned extremely well for growth once these systems are fully implemented and aligned.

We’ll continue guiding the team closely through the process and keeping everyone on track through Slack and the biweekly strategy calls.

Looking forward to building this out with you all.

Bethany
The Luxora Collective
:::
